But why does this work? When customers pay for loyalty, they are more likely to engage with the brand to justify their investment. This creates a cycle of interaction and repeat purchases, enhancing lifetime value. However, the success of such programs hinges on the value they deliver. For brands considering similar strategies, the key lies in clear communication of benefits and ensuring that the value proposition is compelling enough to offset the annual fee.
